review_reference: Owner decision Q43 of 2026-11-11 (OCR learning: rules switch on only after 5 identical corrections from 3 staff, suggestions only, sensitive classes excluded, kill switch per rule set) and the coordinator's answers of the same day; to be signed by the owner (0118 and 0119 separately).
evidence: Migration 0118 and 0119. 0118_ocr_correction_observations.sql plus its runtime-grants.sql block. WHAT IT DOES: two new tables in schema ocr, granted to no runtime role (row-level security forced, one owner policy each): ocr.learning_key (one row, a 32-byte key made by the migration with gen_random_bytes; no deployment secret, coordinator decision of 2026-11-11) and ocr.correction_observations (facility, field class, SHA-256 digest of the value the AI reading gave, the closed-list value the reviewer saved or NULL, HMAC-SHA-256 of the staff account under that key, HMAC of the validation id, time; the digest itself is stored as its HMAC under the key, so no row can be checked against guessed text or joined to a validation without the key). Nothing read from a paper is stored: ocr-api sends a digest, never the text, and only drug-list, strength, frequency-code, lab-test and lab-unit values. Two SECURITY DEFINER functions: ocr.record_correction_observations (OCR API; a staff session holding ocr.validation.write, its own accepted validation of the last 10 minutes, at most 200 well-formed entries, idempotent per validation and key; also deletes rows older than 180 days) and ocr.purge_correction_observations (OCR worker account only; 180-day retention, oldest first). KEY NOTE: database dumps and backups carry the HMAC key with the rows; the key only pseudonymises staff counts (it never identifies anyone by itself and protects no patient data), so this is accepted. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: nothing existing changes; today's ocr-api, ocr-worker and identity-api images never call the new functions. LOCKS: only the new tables and SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on identity.facilities (the foreign key); no existing row read or written. TESTS: services/ehr-api/test/database/ocr-correction-observations.integration.sql (42 cases as the exact runtime roles: grants, forced RLS, no table privilege, the HMAC, refusals for another facility/membership/old/rejected validation, malformed lists, purge). 0119_ocr_learning_rules.sql plus its runtime-grants.sql block (needs 0118). WHAT IT DOES: three new tables (ocr.learning_rules, ocr.learning_rule_showings, ocr.learning_switches; no runtime privilege, RLS forced) and six functions. A rule switches on by itself only after at least 5 identical corrections from at least 3 staff with no conflicting correction in the last 180 days and after any retirement (facility rule at one facility; platform rule combined, from at least 2 facilities); it is a suggestion only, never a change to a saved value; it retires itself when 3 of its last 10 showings were not taken; owner kill switch per rule set, on by default, set only by a platform super admin (platform audit row admin.ocr.learning-switch.set). ocr.reading_suggestions returns the active rule per key for staff holding ocr.job.read. ocr.review_outcome_summary is the platform-wide phase-1 review-outcome summary (platform.admin.access and platform.operations.read, aggregate only, groups under 20 suppressed in SQL, audited). Owner decision Q43 of 2026-11-11 and the coordinator's answers (kept_unchanged neither support nor conflict; 180 days; combined platform evidence; re-arm only from evidence after retirement). Sensitive classes (ARVs/HIV, TB, psychiatric, sickle cell) are excluded in ocr-api: a document or review touching them stores nothing, and a sensitive value is never suggested. ocr.purge_learning_showings lets the OCR worker apply the 180-day retention to showings. ocr-api calls the learning commands after the validation committed, in their own READ COMMITTED transaction (advisory locks per key and per rule). BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: nothing existing changes; older images never call the new functions. LOCKS: only the new tables and SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on identity.facilities. TESTS: services/ehr-api/test/database/ocr-learning-rules.integration.sql (65 cases: switch-on and every non-switch-on case, platform rule, precedence, kill switches, retirement, re-arm, refusals, summary suppression and audit).
